Idols are Items which may be equipped into the Idol Inventory slot of Player Characters.

## Overview[]

Idols are unmodifiable statuettes that always come with a prefix and a suffix. They can be put in a dedicated Idol Inventory, where they take up some space in a grid, based on type. Larger and longer idols generally provide better bonuses, such as granting a chance to cast skills or enhancing properties of class-specific abilities.

Larger idols are class-specific, and they are weighted towards rolling affixes based on the class in play.

### Idol types[]

| Name | Size | Prefixes | Suffixes |

| Small Idol | 1x1 | Damage over Time, Dodge Rating, HP Regen, Healing Effectiveness, Stun Chance | Non-Elemental Resistance, Shared Non-Elemental Damage |

| Humble Idol | 2x1 | Bleed Chance on Hit, Poison Chance on Hit, Health on Kill, Stun Duration, Vitality | Non-Elemental Resistance, Shared Non-Elemental Damage |

| Stout Idol | 1x2 | Ward Gained on Hit, Ignite Chance on Hit, Shock Chance on Hit, Critical Strike Chance, Freeze Rate Multiplier, Health, Potion HP converted to Ward | Elemental Resistance, Health, Shared Elemental Damage |

| Adorned Idol | 2x2 | Varies, some class-specific augments | Block Effectiveness, Chance To Shred Armor on Melee Hit, Health, Increased Physical Damage Over Time, Increased Void Damage Over Time, Chance to Shred Armor on Hit with Throwing, Fire Penetration With Melee Attacks, Percent Missing Health Restored On Lunge, Chance to Shred Armor on Hit with Fire Skills, Chance to Shred Armor on Melee Hit, Fire Resistance |

| Grand Idol | 3x1 | Varies, some class-specific augments, Transformation augments | Varies, some class-specific augments, Non-Elemental Resistance, Shared Non-Elemental Damage |

| Large Idol | 1x3 | Varies, some class-specific augments | Varies, mostly Damage and Defenses |

| Ornate Idol | 4x1 | Varies, few class-specific augments, offensive augments | Varies, mostly Buffs and Ailments, Non-Elemental Resistance, Shared Non-Elemental Damage |

| Huge Idol | 1x4 | Varies, mostly class-specific augments | Varies, mostly Damage, Ailments, and Defenses |
